blocks.text: 桑达尔·皮查伊对德米斯·哈萨比斯不再负责运营DeepMind以及杰夫·迪恩离开谷歌的解释：

inlines.text: 桑达尔·皮查伊对德米斯·哈萨比斯不再负责运营DeepMind以及杰夫·迪恩离开谷歌的解释：

blocks.text: “你会看到自然的演变，因为人们会在一段时间内专注于做某些事情……能与杰夫长期共事，我感到很自豪。显然，他在这里的贡献具有开创性，我们也很期待看到他在Discovery Loop做出什么。

inlines.text: “你会看到自然的演变，因为人们会在一段时间内专注于做某些事情……能与杰夫长期共事，我感到很自豪。显然，他在这里的贡献具有开创性，我们也很期待看到他在Discovery Loop做出什么。

blocks.text: 我想说，你正经历着行业中的一个时刻，前沿模型的开发是一件耗费全部精力的事情。我们有过广泛的人工智能研究、AGI研究等等，但前沿模型的开发是耗费全部精力的。它在推进，在加快步伐，而且是一个规模非常大的运营，从数据和算力到你做的算法工作，再到管理团队和你的模型智能体。我认为这整体上已经成为一项重要的工作。

inlines.text: 我想说，你正经历着行业中的一个时刻，前沿模型的开发是一件耗费全部精力的事情。我们有过广泛的人工智能研究、AGI研究等等，但前沿模型的开发是耗费全部精力的。它在推进，在加快步伐，而且是一个规模非常大的运营，从数据和算力到你做的算法工作，再到管理团队和你的模型智能体。我认为这整体上已经成为一项重要的工作。

blocks.text: 德米斯显然已经思考这个时刻很久了。他特别感兴趣的是，如何安全地度过这个前沿时刻，以及如何将其应用于解决其他问题。他在AlphaFold上所做的工作，以及我们现在在Isomorphic所做的工作，都是如何应用AGI解决其他问题的例子……我认为他想把更多时间花在这些事情上”

blocks.text: Sundar Pichai's explanation for Demis Hassabis stepping back from running DeepMind and Jeff Dean leaving Google:

inlines.text: Sundar Pichai's explanation for Demis Hassabis stepping back from running DeepMind and Jeff Dean leaving Google:

blocks.text: "You're seeing natural evolutions as people spend their time doing things for a while... I feel proud to have worked together with Jeff for a long time. Obviously, he was seminal in his contributions here, and we're excited to see what he does with Discovery Loop.

inlines.text: "You're seeing natural evolutions as people spend their time doing things for a while... I feel proud to have worked together with Jeff for a long time. Obviously, he was seminal in his contributions here, and we're excited to see what he does with Discovery Loop.

blocks.text: I would say you're going through a moment in the industry where frontier model development is an all-consuming thing. We've had broad AI research, AGI research, and so on, but frontier model development is all-consuming. It's moving, picking up pace, and it's a very scaled operation, all the way from data and compute to the algorithmic work you do, to managing the teams and your model agents. I think it's become an important job in its entirety.

blocks.text: Demis has obviously been thinking about this moment for a long time. He's particularly interested in both how you go through this frontier moment safely and how you apply it to solve other problems. The work he did with AlphaFold and what we are doing now with Isomorphic are examples of how you can apply AGI to solve other problems... I think he wants to spend more of his time on those things"
